example-cs0103.title: CS0103: The name does not exist in the current context
example-cs0103.short: A name cannot be resolved by the compiler
example-cs0103.summary: A representative compiler error for an unknown variable, method, or symbol.
example-cs0103.why: Common causes include use before declaration, spelling mistakes, or an invalid scope.
example-cs0103.tips: Check both the failing line and where the symbol is declared.
